name: Devon Energy
outlook:
What Devon Energy says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: production and capitalFor the fourth quarter of 2026, total production is expected to average between 1,660,000 and 1,700,000 Boe per day and oil production is expected to average between 550,000 and 560,000 barrels per day. Capital spending in the fourth quarter is expected to be between $1,290 million and $1,395 million.
  • Full year 2027: initial viewOn a pro forma basis, adjusted for the Eagle Ford sale, the company expects 2027 oil production of approximately 525,000 barrels per day and total production of approximately 1,600,000 Boe per day on total capital of approximately $5.3 billion.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
